text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Hopeful Stakes. Mejiro 
Dober, who had already claimed a GⅠ 
victory, rushed over to cheer her on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, seeing Mejiro Bright and her 
Trainer acting so laid-back, a worried 
look appeared on their face. They wondered 
if she would really be all right before a 
G1 race...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, for Mejiro Bright, "this was just 
fine." Trusting her, the Trainer sent her 
off with words of encouragement: "Just run 
calmly, and you'll do great."
